name: Local speech server
description: Transcription and a voice from a server you run, such as Speaches, whisper.cpp or Kokoro.

provider.note: On a phone, the server needs an HTTPS address, such as a tunnel: localhost only reaches the device annai runs on.

transcription.note: Speaches or whisper.cpp, at the provider's address. Add models by id, or with Fetch model list.

voice.note: Kokoro or Speaches, at its own address. Add a voice model by id.
